name: The Corrupter
summary: Maurin Bonesplitter seeks an oracle crystal to find the demon lord Azrethoc. Northwest along the coast, the Slitherblade naga dwell in a vast coral reef, and they will take your intrusion badly.

sections.title: An Oracle Crystal
sections.body: Maurin Bonesplitter needs an oracle crystal to find the demon lord Azrethoc. The skin you brought him bore Azrethoc's signature. Naga craft these crystals for their oracles, who dwell in a vast coral reef northwest along the coast. The Slitherblade naga live there near the shore. They are deadly and will take your intrusion badly, so Maurin urges you to move carefully and quickly.

sections.title: A Shared Prize
sections.body: Maurin says finding and destroying Lord Azrethoc would earn you both much favor with the Warchief. Working together and moving swiftly serves each of your aims.

faq.q: Why does Maurin Bonesplitter need an oracle crystal?
faq.answer: So that Maurin Bonesplitter can find the demon lord Azrethoc.

faq.q: Where are the oracle crystals found?
faq.answer: The naga craft oracle crystals for their oracles, who dwell in a vast coral reef northwest along the coast from Maurin.
The Slitherblade are naga who call a vast coral reef near the shore home. Maurin calls them deadly and says they will take intruders badly.
Azrethoc is the demon lord whose signature was on the skin you brought Maurin. Maurin wants to find and destroy him.

faq.q: What motivates Maurin to hunt this demon?
faq.answer: The Warchief's favor: Maurin says finding and destroying Lord Azrethoc would earn you both a great deal of it.
